Sandbox_BanditRadio_Range_tooltip: How far from the player bandit transmissions can be heard.
Sandbox_BanditRadio_ScanInterval_tooltip: How often bandit movements are analysed. Lower = more reports, slightly more CPU.
Sandbox_BanditRadio_Overhead: Show live messages above the player
Sandbox_BanditRadio_LogWhenOff: Save messages while the radio is off
Sandbox_BanditRadio_Reliability_tooltip: Complete: every event in full detail. Realistic: mix of full info, partial info, rumors and silence. Rumors: only vague info.
Sandbox_BanditRadio_FalseRumors_tooltip: Chance that a fake rumor is broadcast. You can never fully trust the radio.
Sandbox_BanditRadio_EvPlayers: Events: bandits hunting / closing in on players
Sandbox_BanditRadio_MapMarkers: Show intel zones on the map
